purpose: Teach: 渦/大雪/鮨/呪文/電灯/コンセント/キノコ/ハンバーガー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが海の渦に巻き込まれそうになった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he almost got caught in a sea whirlpool.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate opening. Soft, drifting tone like pulling up an old memory. Pause between thought and speech. Gentle weight on the dangerous image, but distant — a story from long ago.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、大雪の日に外出されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and your grandfather went out in that heavy snow, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm agreement, then a gentle pivot. Soft questioning lilt at the end. Not correcting — offering her own memory back to him. Tender and slightly amused at how he circles.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと初めて鮨を食べに行ったぞ
lines.en: Gran, I remember the first time I went for sushi with your father when I was young.
lines.style: Softer this time, more intimate. Words arriving like he's seeing it again. Slight pause before 'sushi' — the smallness of it mattering more than the event.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、孫に呪文のような暗号を教えてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather did teach our grandchild that funny little code, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle teasing warmth. The word 'funny' carries light amusement. She's remembering something he taught, something secret between them. Settling into her own recollection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは古い電灯を直されたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your father fixed an old lamp for us.
lines.style: Even quieter now. Almost a whisper. The specificity of 'old lamp' carries quiet pride — not in the act, but in the man. Trailing slightly, like he's still seeing your father's hands at work.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、コンセントの位置をご自分で考えられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather figured out where the outlet should go all by himself, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warmth with underlying admiration. She's defending his practicality gently. The 'all by himself' carries quiet pride in him. Close and intimate — she knows exactly what kind of man he was.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、山でキノコ狩りをしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, we went mushroom picking in the mountains.
lines.style: The weariness lifting slightly. A moment of lightness. Gentle, almost dreaming. The sensory memory arriving — forest, earth, the simple hunt. Voice settling into the peace of it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様にハンバーガーをご馳走されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather took our grandchild out for a hamburger after that, remember, dear?
lines.style: Warm, knowing smile in the voice. A touch of tender teasing — he gave them the adventure and the treat both. The final memory arriving like she's been waiting to add it. Close and loving.
